programme.desc: It is time for “Angry Planet” to do a serious desert episode. What better place to do it than this fabled city in the middle of the mighty Sahara Desert.This almost mythical place really does exist. programme.desc: No-one creates eco-disasters on quite the scale of the former Soviet Union.
